extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism ontology record from primary text and figure captions; automated protein/nucleic-acid locator notes were removed.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The phage-displayed heptapeptide SYWVRAS is supported as the targeting domain selected for S. aureus binding.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: SYWVRAS targeting domain in chimeric peptides

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=3:Designing peptides based on phage display technology; xml:fig=1:Figure 1

mechanism_claims.limitations: Selection/binding evidence supports targeting-domain choice; it is not itself bactericidal mechanism closure.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: SFK2 directly binds or competes at S. aureus lipoteichoic acid in a fluorescence displacement assay.
mechanism_claims.limitations: LTA binding supports cell-envelope targeting but does not quantify full in vivo target occupancy.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: SFK2 induces cytoplasmic membrane depolarization/permeability changes in S. aureus.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Direct membrane-potential/permeability readout; downstream molecular targets beyond the membrane are not demonstrated.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: SFK2 damages S. aureus membrane integrity and morphology in microscopy/flow-cytometry assays.

source_locator.locator: xml:fig=4:Figure 4; xml:sec=24:Membrane integrity observation; xml:sec=26:Flow cytometry; xml:sec=27:SEM and TEM characterization

mechanism_claims.limitations: Direct damage evidence is strongest for SFK2 against S. aureus; it should not be generalized to every designed peptide.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: SFK2 shows therapeutic efficacy phenotypes in mouse and piglet S. aureus infection models.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: SFK2 in S. aureus infection models

source_locator.locator: xml:fig=6:Figure 6; xml:fig=7:Figure 7; xml:sec=30:Analysis of antibacterial activity in vivo

mechanism_claims.limitations: In vivo efficacy supports biological activity but does not add a distinct molecular mechanism beyond membrane/LTA evidence.
